about_short_description.short_description: Algoriz is a platform that lets any trader write algorithms in plain English.

product.name: Algorithmic Trading Platform
product.description: A platform that allows traders to create and test trading strategies using algorithms written in plain English, without needing programming skills.

product.name: Tutorial Videos
product.description: Videos available to users after signing up, designed to help them learn how to use the platform.

product.name: Security and Privacy
product.description: Ensures users' strategies are kept secure and private, without sharing them with others.

product.name: Slippage Model
product.description: A model used by the platform to estimate the slippage cost in real trading, considering factors like liquidity and order size.

product.name: Equities Trading Support
product.description: The platform currently supports trading in equities, with plans to expand to FX and commodities.
